why: The factory console is the reference the owner holds v3 against: its StatCard is the accepted card anatomy, and its pages are what an app built on basalt should look like. The area cycles test one piece each; this one tests whether v3 rebuilds a real app slice at the console's quality. Cycle 4 (docs/v3/cycles/dogfood-4.md) found 0 P1 and 4 P2; this cycle rebuilds on the fixes. Protocol: docs/v3/CYCLES.md.
what: Cycle 5 of the dogfood area: rebuild the console overview slice on v3 in the playground, compare it with the console, log, file.
owns: apps/playground/src/** (the cycle build only: new files plus nav registration)
change: Read the console's Overview page (`routes/index.tsx`; `/flow` redirects there since cycle 4) and its kit (software-factory apps/console/src, read-only; components/kit/stat-card.tsx is the card reference, components/flow/{trend-chart,issue-table}.tsx the chart card and the table), and the four cards at the top of docs/v3/inspo/herdr-paste-1794228224613846000.png. Rebuild the overview slice in the playground on v3 with the console's fixture shapes: the stat row, the Issues over time card with its Count and Window choice, the issue table with its filters, and the aside. Build it fresh in apps/playground/src/cycle/dogfood-5/ on route /cycle/dogfood-5, leave the earlier cycles' builds as they are, and keep the `?screen=` switch for the phase shots. Shoot it at 1800x1200 and 390x844 in light and dark, ready and in each phase (loading, empty, error, stale), with the aside open and with filters that match nothing. Rerun cycle 4's probes (`.evidence/cycle-dogfood-4/probe*.ts` in its worktree, or the same checks): the row mark, its computed background as well as its attribute, and the URL on a deep link, focus after close, the column widths and cut cells, the phone header button, the widget's URL key, the State column's widest label, the segmented groups' cells, the page summary's aria-busy in each phase. Pick widget ids no earlier cycle's page uses, or check that dogfood-4.1 lets them repeat. Compare it region by region with the console's code and the inspo: spacing, type sizes and weights, surface steps, contrast, density, and the states. Count: lines in the v3 slice against the console's lines for the same slice; escape hatches; regions that look worse than the console, each with the reason; and put cycles 1 to 4's numbers beside them in a trend table.
commits: Playground build in its own commit (feat:), findings and plan rows in a docs: commit. No package commit.
proof: docs/v3/cycles/dogfood-5.md with the sha, the shot paths, a region-by-region comparison table and the findings table.
acceptance: docs/v3/cycles/dogfood-5.md exists, names the master sha and the console commit read, and has the region-by-region table
The slice renders in the playground and imports basalt-ui only through published subpaths
Every region rated worse than the console is a finding with evidence
Every P1 has its own plan row with a brief; the P2s are grouped one row per class; or the file states convergence
If the cycle did not converge, a v3-cycle-dogfood-6 row exists after every fix row
git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD lists nothing under packages/basalt-ui/
out_of_scope: Fixing any finding in this PR; editing the console; console pages outside the overview slice.
